description: Defines the TConnectedClient class which manages a client connection to a TServer, including processing loop and cleanup procedures.

classes.name: TConnectedClient
classes.description: Represents a connected client to a TServer, managing its lifecycle and processing loop.

methods.name: TConnectedClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client connection with processor, protocols, event handler, and transport.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the client processing loop until the client disconnects or an error occurs.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup after client disconnect or error, closing transports and handling context.
